_note: 仅新增键。父代理把 zh-CN.payment / en.payment 下的键并入各自 frontend/web/i18n/locales/{zh-CN,en}.json 的 admin.commerce.payment 节点（既有键不动）。media cover 为纯 API 能力，无 UI 文案，故无新增键。

payment.taxCalcHint: 按国家/地区/税种匹配当前生效税率并计税（税率来自税务配置）。金额含税时从总额拆出；填合法 EU VAT 号按免税处理。未配置对应税率会直接报错，不会按 0 计税。
payment.taxCalcRequired: 请填写金额与 2 位国家代码
payment.taxCalcCountryRequired: 请填写 2 位国家代码
payment.taxReportHint: 周期税务报表：税率配置清单 + 已结算交易按币种汇总（需收益查看权限）。
payment.taxReportEmptyDesc: 设置统计天数后点击「生成报表」

payment.taxCalcHint: Matches the currently active rate by country/region/tax type and computes the tax (rates come from tax configs). When the amount is tax-inclusive the tax is split out of the total; a valid EU VAT number is treated as exempt. A missing rate fails outright instead of silently taxing at 0.
payment.taxCalcRequired: Please enter the amount and a 2-letter country code
payment.taxReportHint: Periodic tax report: tax config list + settled transactions summarised by currency (requires revenue view permission).
payment.taxReportEmptyDesc: Set the period and click “Generate Report”
